about: Names and terms as Web Speech mishears them ("Mutu Kumar", "Razaly", "red only", "gira"); the glossary should give owners and terms their right spelling.
lines: Morning. Quick one on the payment rollout.
Hi, Mutu Kumar here. The fpx sandbox is working again. I will run the regression by Thursday.
Great. Razaly, can you keep the old checkout red only until the rollout?
Yes, I'll switch it to red only on Monday.
Nurul Ein, can you log the open defects in gira by Friday?
Will do, I'll log them in gira today and finish by Friday.
We agreed to go live on the fifteenth if the regression passes.
